articles.summary: You know her well. She's the one who always manages to look effortlessly pulled together, whether she's crossing off her to-do list or boarding her next flight. This season, fill her stocking (and her day) with cheerful surprises in our Rachel Ditsy pattern, a sweet, small-scale floral that's both timeless and a little playful. Each piece feels like a love letter to her creativity and her knack for finding beauty in the details. Bancroft Backpack Bag Charm Because even her accessories deserve accessories. This tiny charmer takes whimsy to new heights. The Bancroft Backpack Bag Charm brings a touch of personality to any tote, handbag, or keyring, proving that good style really does come in small packages. With a hinge ring for easy attachment, a front zip pocket for that miniature moment of functionality, and a zip closure, it's as polished as it is playful. "Small yet versatile... I love how it clips on to my purse." ~ Holley Shop more Keychains and Charms in fun patterns and styles! Mini Notebook Set of 2 For the one who still believes in writing it down. Big ideas don't wait for Wi-Fi. These Mini Notebooks are ready for every flash of inspiration, grocery list, or doodle worth keeping. Compact enough to slip into a purse or pocket, each notebook has 64 lined pages of smooth, wood-free paper waiting for her next big thought. The textured covers add a tactile touch that feels every bit as thoughtful as the words she'll fill them with. "Cute printed notebooks. Small but good size to fit in a purse." ~ Grace Shop more Mini Notebooks in patterns she'll love plus matching pens and more! Zip Card Pouch Minimalism, mastered. When she's on the move, she likes to travel light. That's why our Zip Card Pouch is the perfect travel accessory since it keeps her essentials in check without weighing her down. Ideal for cards, cash, and those just-in-case receipts, this petite piece proves you don't need a lot of space to stay organized. The hinge ring makes it easy to clip onto her keys or bag charm, while the zip closure keeps everything secure. "Perfect size for a little cash and a couple cards for a trip or night out when you don't need everything." ~ Michael Why stop there? Find a fun organizing pouch or lanyard to match! Lia Polarized Sunglasses Because she shines… and she knows it! Whether she's running errands or catching rays, our Lia Polarized Sunglasses bring instant polish (and full UV protection) to her look. The handmade acetate frame feels luxe, while the polarized gradient lenses keep glare at bay with crisp, color-true clarity. Finished with a microfiber pouch. Even her eyewear can enjoy its moment in the sun! Not quite her style? There are plenty more sunglasses (and reading glasses) to choose from! The Bancroft Backpack The grand finale to her perfectly patterned story. Stocking stuffers are essential. Yet, you need a bigger gift that's a real showstopper. And the Bancroft Backpack is just that. It's the beautifully coordinated companion that brings all her charming little accessories together in one effortlessly stylish package. Crafted for real life (and real schedules), the Bancroft features two roomy zip compartments, a padded laptop sleeve, and plenty of interior and exterior pockets to keep everything beautifully organized from her writing essentials to her sunglasses. Thoughtful touches like a trolley sleeve for travel, adjustable straps, and a ring made just for charms make it as functional as it is beautiful. "Versatile and beautiful!" ~ Deborah It's the kind of piece that proves coordination isn't about matching; it's about harmony. Together, these favorites create a look that's joyful, intentional, and completely her. Wrap It Up with a Bow (or a Backpack) When you fill her stocking with pieces this thoughtful, every little unwrapping moment feels big. From charming bag accessories to sunglasses to her new favorite carryall that ties it all together, the best gifts are the ones she'll use (and love) every day. SHOP ALL STOCKING STUFFERS

articles.summary: If there's one thing she doesn't need, it's another gift that looks good on a shelf but collects dust. These favorites, each under $50, prove that practical can still feel personal, and stylish doesn't have to come with a sky-high price tag. The Large Cosmetic Bag: Beauty Meets Function For the friend whose skincare lineup could rival a Sephora shelf, this is her bag. Our Large Cosmetic Bag brings serious organization to beauty chaos, with enough room for every serum, lipstick, and skincare essential. Favorite Features Its wide shape and exterior zip pocket keep everything where it belongs (so she can finally stop digging for that elusive mascara). The Blake Crossbody: Lighten Up (In the Best Way) Some days call for a little less baggage… literally. The Blake Crossbody is for the minimalist who still appreciates a standout style moment. Favorite Features Compact yet functional, it carries the essentials with ease while keeping her hands free and her outfit polished. The adjustable strap and interior zip pocket make it feel effortless, whether she's brunching, exploring, or just conquering her day in style. The sleek design, secure zip pockets, and adjustable strap make it a modern classic she'll reach for on repeat. "Great travel bag for security and safety. This bag was big enough to carry everything I needed including passports, sunglasses, wallet, etc., with room to spare." ~ Brenda Think she'll prefer something smaller? Check out the Woodward Small Belt Bag and more in our Belt Bags collection! Wrap It Up (Literally!) From beauty essentials to quick trips out the door, these under-$50 finds are proof that great gifts don't need a big budget. They just need great taste. Whether you're shopping for your sister, your bestie, or your partner, these are the kinds of gifts that actually make the everyday a little easier. SHOP ALL GIFTS UNDER $50

articles.summary: When the air turns crisp, your style turns creative. This fall, meet the pieces that will carry you from apple-picking mornings to candlelit evenings, wrapped in warmth, stitched in artistry, and finished with just the right flourish. Think of it as functional fashion with a side of “I’ve got this.” Whether you’re searching for a women’s fall jacket that feels like a warm hug or fall fashion accessories that spark joy every time you reach for them, these are the pieces that will move with you and tell your story while they do. Patchwork Jacket: Your Personality, in Jacket Form Every panel is its own little love letter to individuality. This Premium Cotton jacket is a gallery of texture and color, stitched together in a way that feels effortless yet intentional, just like your approach to life. It’s cut from 100% cotton for breathable comfort, with an easy silhouette that layers beautifully over everything from turtlenecks to tees. And because no two are alike, slipping one on is a bit like putting on your signature. Care tip: a soft, damp cloth with mild detergent is all it takes to keep it looking as artful as the day you found it. Quilted Jacket: Your Everyday Wrap of Wonder Here’s your reminder that women’s lightweight fall jackets can still feel like a hug. Lightly padded for just-right warmth, this quilted cotton jacket brings polished comfort without the bulk. It’s the kind of piece that makes layering easy and elevates every look with quiet confidence. School run? Coffee date? Long walk at golden hour? This jacket will be there, matching your pace and your energy with no effort required. Care tip: To keep it as timeless as it feels, spot clean and line dry. It’s easy like that. Square Silk Scarf: The Artful Finishing Touch Your outfit’s not complete: it’s curated. This silk scarf delivers that “oh, this old thing?” energy in the best way. Light as air yet rich in color and print, it’s equally at home knotted at your neck, tied in your hair, or wrapped on your bag handle like a personal flourish. It’s a petite piece with major impact, exactly what fall fashion accessories are meant to be. Bonus: it comes in a gift box, in case you’re feeling generous (with yourself or someone else). Dimensions: 25.5" w x 25.5" h Mini Umbrella: Small Size, Big Statement Rain can try, but it won’t dull your sparkle. This compact umbrella fits easily in your bag yet pops open to a generous canopy at the first sign of drizzle. Its sleek, ergonomic design and auto-open-and-close feature make staying dry feel chic. Dimensions (closed): 2.0" w x 7.5" hCanopy Size: 38"Weight: 0.66 lb Lamoille Polarized Sunglasses: Shaded in Style Crisp fall light calls for a little eye protection and a lot of attitude. These polarized sunglasses block glare while adding instant polish, thanks to their flattering silhouette and signature Vera Bradley prints along the temples. Whether you’re on a road trip or just running errands in style, they deliver comfort, clarity, and a whisper of personality only you could pull off. Dimensions: 53 - 21 - 140 The Final Fall Layer: Confidence You already know how to do fall, so these jackets and accessories just make things more fun. So here’s to fall, in all its golden, ever-changing glory. May your jacket feel like a hug, your accessories feel like you, and your reflection feel like the truest kind of wonder. articles.summary: When your calendar is full of pumpkin patch strolls, leaf-peeping road trips, and impromptu wine tastings, you need accessories as adaptable (and stylish) as you are. These multifunctional favorites were made to keep up with your every autumn adventure and to complement your autumn outfits with a wink of effortless charm. Plus, we'll share how to pair our favorite fall bags with outfits that move the way you do. Astoria Shoulder Bag Being Chic Shouldn't Be Complicated Our Astoria Shoulder Bag is your answer to that magical sweet spot where form meets function. Its relaxed silhouette keeps your vibe casual-cool, while the spacious interior easily stashes a scarf for chilly orchard breezes, or yes, even that just-purchased bottle of pinot. The genuine leather trim and adjustable handle mean it's as polished as it is practical, ready to carry you from afternoon fall fun straight into a dinner reservation. "Great purse. Love the pattern!" ~ Maria Pair it With: Effortless Layering A relaxed midi dress, cozy knit cardigan, and ankle boots create an easy base for a full day of adventure. Add the Astoria Shoulder Bag as your laid-back statement piece. Think of it as the exclamation point on your “I woke up like this” energy. Blake Crossbody Minimal Effort, Maximum Freedom Think of the Blake Crossbody as your ticket to hands-free happiness. Compact yet deceptively organized, it tucks away your essentials so you can hold onto your cider doughnut in one hand and snap fall foliage pics with the other. The sleek leather trim and adjustable strap let you wear it high and close or low and relaxed because the only thing you should be adjusting on your day out is your playlist. "Love this purse and love the size! It's perfect!" ~ Linda Pair it With: City Chic When you're zipping between coffee shops, wine tastings, and vintage markets, reach for your Blake Crossbody. Pair it with high-waisted jeans, a tucked-in turtleneck, and a longline coat. It keeps your essentials secure and your hands free for espresso sipping or impromptu antique hunting. Small Hathaway Tote Bag Because 'Travelling Light' Is Easier Said Than Done The Small Hathaway Tote is the MVP of spontaneous plans. Need space for your cardigan, a new novel from the local bookstore, and that irresistible farmers market bouquet? Done. Its sophisticated structure and generous top width keep everything in place while its button and tie closures add a touch of tailored charm to your cozy layered look. "Easy to carry, comfortable to use, and as cute as they come!" ~ Lorna Pair it With: Casual Weekend Vibes Chunky knit sweater, wide-leg trousers, and sneakers: the ultimate cozy-meets-polished trio. The Small Hathaway Tote ties it all together with structure and space, sliding effortlessly from farmers market hauls to sunset picnics. Its roomy top width makes it ideal for carrying an extra scarf or the cinnamon bread you couldn't resist. Small Banbury Backpack Your Sidekick for Fall Wandering Adventures move fast, so this backpack makes sure you do, too. Our Small Banbury Backpack offers exterior pockets for easy-grab items (snacks, sunglasses, a tiny travel umbrella) and interior compartments to keep your essentials sorted. The adjustable straps promise all-day comfort, whether you're wandering through a vineyard or chasing down the last hayride of the day. "I absolutely love this backpack! It's the perfect size for everyday use" - Jokeitha Pair it With: Autumn Explorer Style Leggings, a quilted vest, and hiking boots are a no-fuss combo for orchard trails or leaf-covered lanes. The Small Banbury Backpack keeps your hands free for snapping photos of the foliage and holding that caramel apple you definitely earned. Bonus: the exterior pockets make finding your sunglasses (or lip balm) a breeze. Zip Wristlet Essentials in Hand, Fun on the Agenda Our Zip Wristlet proves that less can truly be more, keeping your essentials close with easy, everyday style. It slides into your tote as an extra organizer, then emerges as the star when you just want to travel light. With space for your cards, keys, and a treat (because fall snacking is non-negotiable), it keeps you stylish and swift from apple stand to après-wine. Pair it With: Minimalist Look For quick coffee runs or post-winery dessert stops, go sleek. Tailored trousers, a slouchy sweater, and pointed flats paired with the Zip Wristlet say “effortlessly pulled together” without trying too hard. Tuck it into your larger bag during the day, then let it shine solo at night. You're Ready for It All When You Have the Right Bag Here's the thing about fall: it refuses to stay in one lane. It may be sunny at noon, then chilly by sunset, with a trip to the farmers' market in between. To keep up with the changes in scenery, each of these Vera Bradley favorites was made to move with you through it all. You don't need to slow down your spark to stay stylish! Build your fall travel outfits around pieces that are as adaptable, unexpected, and delightfully you as the season itself. Listen to your muse. Pack the bag. See where the day goes.
